scripts.dev: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('../web/dist', { recursive: true })" && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --var ALLOW_CHEATS:true --var DEV_SERVER:true
scripts.deploy: echo 'Pick a target: npm run deploy:production, deploy:staging or deploy:test' >&2 && exit 1
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy --var RULES_VERSION:$(git describe --always --dirty --abbrev=40)
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --var RULES_VERSION:$(git describe --always --dirty --abbrev=40)
scripts.deploy:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env test && wrangler deploy --env test --var RULES_VERSION:$(git describe --always --dirty --abbrev=40)
